name: HomeDoc
subtitle: Your home, documented
promo: Keep property details, photos, notes, and maintenance plans together—ready when you need them.
description:
Keep the details of a home together in one organized record. HomeDoc helps you save property information, room-by-room notes, photos, and maintenance tasks so useful details are easier to find later.

Organize each property into areas such as a kitchen, utility room, or garage. Add notes and photos, track task status and due dates, and keep records available to the people you choose to share them with. When a home or responsibility changes hands, transfer its record to another HomeDoc account.

For a maintenance task, you can ask HomeDoc's AI planner to suggest clarifying questions, prepare a project plan, and answer follow-up questions. AI requests use task and property context you choose to provide and require your permission. Generated plans and chat are saved with the task.

HomeDoc includes:
• Property and area records
• Notes with photo attachments
• Maintenance tasks, status, and due dates
• AI-assisted maintenance planning and follow-up chat
• Property sharing, contractor area access, and transfer tools

Due dates are saved with tasks; HomeDoc does not currently send due-date notifications. AI availability and account limits may vary by plan.

Start free with one home and a small monthly AI allowance. Optional HomeDoc Pro adds properties and more AI requests through an auto-renewing monthly subscription. See the app for your local price. Manage or cancel Apple subscriptions in your Apple Account settings.
